item.title: When? v1.30.0
item.description:
Features



  • **dedup:** bring the /admin/dedup review tool onto dev (de61802)
  • **events:** backlog-apply script and a category corpus test (6f1239e)
  • **events:** evidence windows across the diplomatic shard (57dcff0)
  • **events:** evidence windows across the five smallest shards (adee466)
  • **events:** evidence windows for 4 conflict events, 34 decided moments (89c5c56)
  • **events:** evidence windows for conflict, infrastructure and cultural (7f16479)
  • **events:** evidence windows for disasters, food, law, money and medicine (a0e1175)
  • **events:** evidence windows for exploration and the first diplomatic chunks (9346e02)
  • **events:** evidence windows for sports and the themes shard (773ff8e)
  • **events:** evidence windows for the cards starved of a source (3701c21)
  • **events:** evidence windows for the cultural shard (00e7a2f)
  • **events:** evidence windows for the shard stragglers, sourced by fetch (3a224a3)
  • **events:** evidence windows for themes and the first infrastructure chunks (4c7af4f)
  • **events:** finish the range-only sweep of the catalogue (33909d1)
  • filter custom games by world region (#69) (bcfd56d)
  • region filter for custom games (wip, pending the tag sweep) (d0846d3)
  • region filter, iOS 27 launch fix and the dev integration work (#70) (e4fbe98)


Bug Fixes



  • **events:** correct names, descriptions and prose; recategorise misfiles; retire duplicates (746b362)
  • **events:** move 24 years to the start of their evidence window (b53a48e)
  • **events:** move 68 years to the start of their evidence window (6aaa7b9)
  • **events:** move years the sources do not support (a8f9a05)
  • **events:** re-tag regions on corrected cards; fix BP ages stored as BCE (afc0a38)
  • **ios:** adopt UIScene lifecycle so the app launches on iOS 27 (#67) (afcb9bc)
  • **scripts:** clear the decided ledger when a re-review writes a window (847c768)
